exams.title: Databricks Data Engineer Associate
exams.blurb: Build and run lakehouse pipelines on Databricks: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, ingestion, transforms, jobs, and basic CI/CD.
exams.blurbPt: Monte e opere pipelines no lakehouse Databricks: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, ingestão, transformações, jobs e CI/CD básico.

exams.title: Databricks Data Engineer Professional
exams.blurb: Advanced Databricks engineering: production Python/SQL, data quality, sharing, monitoring, cost control, security, and deployment.
exams.blurbPt: Engenharia avançada no Databricks: Python/SQL em produção, qualidade de dados, sharing, monitoramento, custo, segurança e deploy.

exams.title: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203)
exams.blurb: Design Azure data platforms with ADLS, Synapse, Data Factory, streaming, security, and performance tuning.
exams.blurbPt: Projete plataformas de dados no Azure com ADLS, Synapse, Data Factory, streaming, segurança e tuning de performance.

exams.title: AWS Data Engineer Associate (DEA-C01)
exams.blurb: Ingest, transform, and operate data on AWS with Glue, EMR, S3, Athena, Redshift, and Lake Formation.
exams.blurbPt: Ingera, transforme e opere dados na AWS com Glue, EMR, S3, Athena, Redshift e Lake Formation.

exams.title: Google Professional Data Engineer
exams.blurb: Design and run data systems on Google Cloud with Pub/Sub, Dataflow, BigQuery, storage choices, and pipeline automation.
exams.blurbPt: Projete e opere sistemas de dados no Google Cloud com Pub/Sub, Dataflow, BigQuery, storage e automação de pipelines.

exams.title: SnowPro Core Certification (COF-C02)
exams.blurb: Learn Snowflake fundamentals: architecture, security, loading, SQL transforms, performance, Time Travel, and sharing.
exams.blurbPt: Fundamentos do Snowflake: arquitetura, segurança, carga, transformações SQL, performance, Time Travel e sharing.

exams.title: dbt Analytics Engineering Certification
exams.blurb: Build reliable analytics models with dbt: materializations, tests, docs, governance, and state-aware workflows.
exams.blurbPt: Construa modelos analíticos confiáveis com dbt: materializations, testes, docs, governança e workflows com state.

exams.title: Claude Certified Architect - Foundations (CCAR-F)
exams.blurb: Design production Claude systems: agentic orchestration, MCP tools, Claude Code, structured outputs, and reliability.
exams.blurbPt: Projete sistemas Claude em produção: orquestração agentic, ferramentas MCP, Claude Code, saídas estruturadas e confiabilidade.

exams.title: Claude Certified Architect - Professional (CCAR-P)
exams.blurb: Lead end-to-end Claude architectures: solution design, RAG/integration, evaluation, governance, and stakeholder lifecycle.
exams.blurbPt: Lidere arquiteturas Claude de ponta a ponta: solution design, RAG/integração, avaliação, governança e ciclo de vida com stakeholders.
